answer_1.quote: The natural language generation (NLG) approach motivates the researchers to focus on generating automated counterspeech.
answer_1.outputs: counterspeech texts generated to counter hate speech

answer_2.quote: We benchmark CSEval on traditional similarity-based metrics, as well as multiple popular single-dimensional (independent), unified, and LLM-based evaluators.

answer_3.quote: we propose Auto Calibrated Chain-of-Thoughts for Counterspeech Evaluation (Auto-CSEval), a prompt-based method with auto-calibrated evaluation steps (CoT) to score each quality dimension of the counterspeech.

answer_4.quote: We recruited five expert annotators who have either published papers or completed senior theses in the domain of hate speech and counterspeech.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate the model output across each of the four dimensions on a Likert scale: contextual-relevance, aggressiveness, argument-coherence, and suitableness.
